integrity: Proof and two standalone checkers included; finite verification is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The known optimal-set size and generic connectivity are credited. Inaccessible full text of a relevant generalized-Petersen paper leaves historical priority risk; the theorem is limited to odd prisms and token jumping. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_scope: Minimum feedback vertex sets and their one-vertex-exchange graph on odd prisms \(C_{2k+1}\square K_2\), \(k\ge2\)
title: Twisted-cube reconfiguration of minimum feedback vertex sets on odd prisms
